{{Quote|This place isn't a fortress. It's a tomb.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, discovering Velerie Tide and other deceased Jedi|<ref name="Kenobi IV" />}}
'''Velerie Tide''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]]<ref name="Dawn" /> [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Kenobi IV AD" /> who was a member of the [[Jedi Order]]. After the [[Galactic Republic]] turned on the [[Jedi]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge]]<ref name="Dawn" /> that began in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date" /> Tide hid her identity and blended in among the locals on the astronomical object [[Athio III]], but was eventually revealed to be a user of [[the Force]] and captured. After she [[Death|died]], her body was entombed in [[Amber (material)|amber]] and displayed in the [[Jedi tomb]] of the [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on the [[moon]] [[Nur]], headquarters of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Jedi hunter|Jedi-hunting]] [[Inquisitorius]].<ref name="Dawn" />

In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date" /> fugitive [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered Tide and the remains of many other captive Jedi in the tomb while infiltrating the [[fortress]] to [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|rescue]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Kenobi IV" /> Tide was entombed with a haunted stare while wearing a [[Limb|hand]]-made [[necklace]], a [[Knitting|knitted]] [[poncho]]<ref name="Kenobi IV AD" /> with [[Color|multicolored]] stripes, and a head [[scarf]] around her dark, curly [[hair]].<ref name="Kenobi IV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Velerie Tide appeared in the [[Part IV|fourth episode]] of the [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] television series,<ref name="Kenobi IV" /> which aired on [[June 8]], [[2022]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-june-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in June 2022}}</ref> The character was not identified in the episode<ref name="Kenobi IV" /> but was named in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'',<ref name="Dawn" /> within a section written by [[Emily Shkoukani]].<ref name="DawnAuthor">{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews - Emily Shkoukani & Jason Fry}}</ref> The page mentioning Tide was revealed prior<ref name="SDCC 2023 panel">{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}}</ref> to the book's [[November 2]], [[2023]] release<ref name="DK UK">{{DK|url=uk/9780241666371-star-wars-dawn-of-rebellion-the-visual-guide|text=Star Wars Dawn of Rebellion The Visual Guide}}</ref> at a [[Lucasfilm]] Publishing panel at [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic Con|San Diego Comic Con]] and in an article on [[StarWars.com]] covering it on [[July 21]], 2023.<ref name="SDCC 2023 panel" />
